name: Real.fourierCoeff_tsum_comp_add
statement: C(ℝ, ℂ)} (hf : ∀ K : Compacts ℝ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ‖(f.comp (ContinuousMap.addRight n)).restrict K‖) (m : ℤ) : fourierCoeff (Periodic.lift <| f.periodic_tsum_comp_add_zsmul 1) m = 𝓕 (f : ℝ → ℂ) m

name: Real.tsum_eq_tsum_fourier
statement: C(ℝ, ℂ)} (h_norm : ∀ K : Compacts ℝ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ‖(f.comp <| ContinuousMap.addRight n).restrict K‖) (h_sum : Summable fun n : ℤ => 𝓕 (f : ℝ → ℂ) n) (x : ℝ) : ∑' n : ℤ, f (x + n) = ∑' n : ℤ, 𝓕 (f : ℝ → ℂ) n * fourier n (x : UnitAddCircle)

name: isBigO_norm_Icc_restrict_atTop
statement: C(ℝ, E)} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f =O[atTop] fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (-b)) (R S : ℝ) : (fun x : ℝ => ‖f.restrict (Icc (x + R) (x + S))‖) =O[atTop] fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (-b)

name: isBigO_norm_Icc_restrict_atBot
statement: C(ℝ, E)} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f =O[atBot] fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (-b)) (R S : ℝ) : (fun x : ℝ => ‖f.restrict (Icc (x + R) (x + S))‖) =O[atBot] fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (-b)
